name: Top-bar hive
definition: a hive whose combs hang from bars.

name: Warre hive
definition: a vertical hive that grows downward with bars in stacked boxes.

name: Smoker
definition: a tool that blows smoke to calm bees.

name: Honey extractor
definition: a machine that spins honey from combs.

name: Uncapping knife or fork
definition: a tool that removes wax cappings from combs.

name: Honey bottling bucket or tank
definition: a bucket or tank that holds honey for bottling.

name: Poultry starter feed
definition: complete feed for chicks.

name: Poultry grower feed
definition: complete feed for growing birds.

name: Poultry layer feed
definition: complete feed for laying hens.

name: Scratch grain
definition: a grain mix fed to poultry as a supplement.

name: Poultry feeder or waterer
definition: a feeder or drinker made for poultry.

name: Chicken coop
definition: a house for backyard hens.

name: Small incubator
definition: a small egg incubator for pet or backyard use; commercial hatchers are not here.

name: Hay
definition: dried grass fed to horses, small mammals and other animals.

name: Food and water bowl
definition: a bowl or dish for food or water, made for more than one animal group.

name: Pet gate
definition: a gate sold only for pets.

name: Pet pen
definition: a pen sold only for pets.

name: Pet camera
definition: a camera sold only for pets.

name: Pet carrier
definition: a carrier that holds an animal and is not a vehicle.

name: Flea, tick and worm treatment
definition: a medicine against parasites in pets.

name: Pet ID tag
definition: a tag worn by a pet that carries its identity.

name: Identification microchip
definition: an implanted chip that identifies an animal.

name: Microchip scanner
definition: a reader of pet identification microchips.

name: GPS pet tracker
definition: a device that tracks a pet's location by GPS.

name: Hive body or super
definition: a box of a hive.

name: Frame
definition: a hive frame that carries comb.

name: Girth
definition: a strap that holds a saddle on a horse.

name: Aquarium filter media
definition: filter material made for one aquarium filter.

name: Dog muzzle
definition: a basket, cage or strap fitted over a dog's muzzle to stop it biting or scavenging.

name: Dog waste bag
definition: a bag made for picking up and disposing of a dog's droppings.

name: Pet door or cat flap
definition: a flap or small door fitted in a door, wall or window that lets a cat or small dog pass in and out.

name: Cat scratcher
definition: a post, pad or board of sisal, cardboard or carpet made for a cat to scratch.

name: Stirrup
definition: a foot rest hung from a saddle for the rider, with or without its leather.

name: Martingale
definition: a strap or straps from the girth to the reins or noseband that limit how high a horse carries its head.

name: Cooler rug
definition: a wicking rug worn by a horse to dry and cool off after work or washing.
